subject: Post-call recap: Atlas Health inference resilience — proposed tests & schedule
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@atlashealth.ai>
Date: 2026-11-16T15:12:00-08:00
Subject: Post-call recap: Atlas Health inference resilience — proposed tests & schedule

Thanks for joining the call today — quick recap and proposed immediate next steps. High-level takeaway: Atlas needs predictable throughput at 50–200 qps for short (<=128 tokens) clinical summarization calls, and resilience for a cross-region failover scenario. They are evaluating Redwood vs two hyperscaler-managed endpoints.

Key differentiators they care about:
- Observable token-level latency and tail latency under load
- Rate-limit behavior (429 vs soft-queueing) and retry semantics
- Failover: cold-start behavior when routed to fallback region/model variant
- Cost per 1M tokens at p95 workload profile

Action items (attached matrix + draft test plan):
1) Run a focused rate-limit/throttle test against Redwood dedicated and a representative hyperscaler endpoint (Ben). Metrics: 429 rate, queuing latency, request drop.
2) Simulate cross-region failover: ramp traffic in primary region to trigger routing fallback; measure cold-start and error budget consumption (Marissa + infra).
3) Collect p50/p95 token latency under continuous batching for 30m windows at 50qps and 200qps (Ben).
4) Share a short procurement timeline and compliance checklist with procurement@atlashealth.ai (me).

Proposed test window options (please confirm):
- Option A: Tue 2026-11-23 10:00–12:00 PT (lighter start-of-week)
- Option B: Thu 2026-11-25 14:00–16:00 PT

I've attached the action matrix and a preliminary test plan. Ben — can you add exact endpoints, load script commands, and expected resource footprint to the test plan by EOD tomorrow? Marissa — can you own the cross-region routing runbook + rollback criteria?

Thanks,
Camila Reyes
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference

- 20261116-atlas-action-matrix.xlsx (xlsx)

On Mon, Nov 16, 2026 at 3:12 PM Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Thanks for joining the call today — quick recap and proposed immediate next steps....

Thanks Camila — added a few technical specifics below and a short checklist for the load tests. I updated redwood-vs-hyperscaler-test-plan.md with endpoint placeholders.

Rate-limit/throttle test (what I'll run):
- Redwood endpoint: https://api.redwood-inference.test/atlas-dedicated/v1/generate
- Hyperscaler endpoint: will substitute once Atlas confirms the target URL (Liam)
- Load tool: vegeta with sustained Poisson arrivals; three phases: 0–50qps (5m), 50–200qps (20m), surge 400qps (5m)
- Metrics to capture: HTTP 429 count, 5xx count, request latency histogram (per-token where available), queueLength (if returned)
- Retry policy: mirror client-side retry (3 attempts, exponential backoff starting 200ms) and record observed duplicates

Cross-region failover runbook (pre-checks):
- Ensure KV cache warm-up script runs for 5m before switching routing
- Canary 10% traffic to fallback for 10m, then 100% cutover if p95 latency < 2x baseline
- Rollback: immediate route reversal + auto-throttle on >5% 5xx for 3 continuous minutes

I'll drop the exact vegeta job and Docker image ref into the drive doc by EOD. If we need to measure cost delta precisely, we'll capture token counts and the per-token billing SKU for each endpoint.

Ben
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Attachment references: redwood-vs-hyperscaler-test-plan.md

Thanks again for the demo earlier. Ben and Marissa proposed two windows for the hands-on tests (details in the attached plan). Can you confirm which slot works for your infra team? Also please confirm the hyperscaler endpoint we'll include in the comparison (we need a public/ingress URL and any auth token).

Quick asks for your side:
- Confirm endpoint URL(s) and contact who can rotate API keys if we need to run longer tests
- Share any maintenance blackout dates for your cluster during the week of Nov 22–28
- Procurement: any timing constraints if we need to provide a short eval contract? procurement@atlashealth.ai is cc'd.

If we get your OK for Tue 11/23 10–12 PT we'll do a dry-run Monday evening to warm caches and validate tooling.

Best,
Camila Reyes
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
